headline: IMF Upgrades Azerbaijan Real GDP and External Balance Forecasts Through 2031
summary: The International Monetary Fund revised its medium-term real GDP growth forecasts for Azerbaijan through 2031, projecting an accelerating improvement in the nation's external balances among oil exporters.
why: Azerbaijan is an important regional supplier of oil and natural gas to Southern Europe and the Caucasus.

impacts.name: Azerbaijan
impacts.why: Improving external balances strengthen sovereign reserve buffers and macro stability.
